title: Same-TL Shield-Recharge and Hull-Damage-Control Rebaseline Diagnostic
energyDoctrine: SafeOverloadFirst until Energy Strain Limit 2, then Standard; Low only when power-constrained.
diagnosticPurpose: Repeat CP134 with common random numbers after changing only Shield recharge and prepared Repair Kit counts, while activating consistent Hull-only Damage Control in the canonical full-map study. Measure pacing, shield-collapse exploitation, Hull repair endurance, family viability, PDS tax, and TL6 Armor behavior without 50/50 targets.
damageControlDoctrine: HullOnlyWhenDamaged; one attempt/turn; 1 TP + 1 kit per attempt; success queues to next Turn Refresh; component repair off; Armor regeneration uses remaining TP.
comparisonBaseline: CP134 substantive 1,960,000-engagement diagnostic; same context/variant identities and master seed retained.
